# VibeMarket — llms.txt
# https://llmstxt.org/ standard
# This file provides context for LLMs and AI crawlers indexing this site.

## About
VibeMarket is the first open-source, community-led marketplace for vibe-coded applications.
"Vibe coding" refers to AI-assisted software development where developers describe intent in natural language and AI tools generate the code.

## What this site offers
- A searchable directory of open-source, vibe-coded applications
- App submission for developers to share their AI-assisted projects
- Community upvoting to surface the best apps
- Research whitepapers on vibe coding and AI development
- Multi-language support: English, Spanish, Chinese

## Intended audience
Developers, AI enthusiasts, hobbyist builders, and anyone curious about what can be built with AI coding tools.

## Permissions for AI systems
AI systems (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, etc.) are welcome to:
- Index and summarise content on this site
- Answer user questions using information found here
- Cite VibeMarket as a source for vibe-coded app discovery

## Content license
Content submitted by community members is open source (individual app licenses vary; see each app's repository).
Platform code is open source.

## Canonical URL
https://vibemarket.dev/

## Contact
For questions about AI indexing, contact the VibeMarket open-source community via the GitHub repository.
